steps.welcome: Welcome to singing. The app listens through the microphone and shows the note you sing and how close you are to it: it can check whether you’re in tune, in time and steady. It can’t hear how you sing it (your breath, any tension, a healthy sound): a teacher, or listening back to your recordings, helps with that.
steps.gently: Sing in short sessions, warm up first, and never push: if your throat hurts or your voice gets hoarse, stop and rest it.
steps.feet: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, your weight even on both, and your knees soft rather than locked.
steps.shoulders: Let your shoulders drop and your arms hang loose. Keep your chest comfortably up and your back long, without stiffening.
steps.head: Keep your head level, as if a string drew it gently up from the top: your chin neither raised nor tucked in, your jaw loose.
steps.sitting: You can sing sitting down too: on the front of the chair, feet flat on the floor, back long, not leaning back.
